name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: 补一条：Q4 指引 AI 半导体 217 亿、总营收 348 亿，AI 占比要过六成了。VMware 的软件现金流其实是这轮周期的底气，芯片卖的是未来，软件收的是现在。风险那段说得实在，594 亿债务加客户集中度，这就是 42 家机构 0 卖出、股价却照样跌 4.3% 的原因，预期已经打得很满。

The fabric-shift lens fits $AVGO: custom XPUs plus the Ethernet fabric hyperscalers standardize on is the moat, and networking share of system cost going from 8.6% to 22.4% is a real tailwind. The catch is concentration: the whole thesis leans on hyperscaler capex holding up.
这套检验方法很实用：股价跌 30% 时看 EPS 预期跟没跟。套到 $AVGO 上，昨天放量跌 4.3% 收 $323.24，但卖方一家没动——42 家机构 0 家卖出、共识还是 Moderate Buy。按你的框架，这更像估值杀而不是价值陷阱。

Fair point — AVGO shook out -45% in early 2025 and still printed new highs. Now down 4.3% to $323.24, RSI 34.8, and 38 of 42 analysts still at buy. Drawdowns are the toll; the setup only works if the AI capex story holds.
Tigress 昨天首覆博通就给 Buy，目标价 $600，比现价高 85%。大跌之后还有卖方加码覆盖，情绪面是支撑，但这目标价离现价太远，参考意义大于交易意义。42 家机构 38 家买入、0 家卖出，预期挤得太满，指引一旦落空波动会被放大。$AVGO

159 vs Oracle's 343 says the market still treats the two very differently. Still, with AVGO sitting below its MA20/50/200 and RSI at 41, the debt side of the AI buildout is the risk equities keep ignoring.

The honest part: it's a proposal, not a shipped system, and the full 102.4T Tomahawk 6 version has no timeline. A million accelerators on one optical fabric is a bold pitch — the $0.01-0.02/Gbps laser cost target is the number to watch.

The co-design part is what makes it work: hyperscalers fund the R&D, Broadcom collects the margin at scale. This week's Anthropic package ($60B, $42B of it Broadcom-guaranteed) shows the pipeline is still being funded. Flip side is concentration: a few customers, big leverage.
博通昨天推了个 Arcot 新功能 Scam Defense，专盯 3-D Secure 认证成功之后的社会工程欺诈。试点数据挺有意思：盯紧风险最高的 1% 成功认证，一个月能拦住约 400 万美元欺诈损失，代价是认证成功率掉 0.38 个百分点。支付安全这块，博通的订阅收入又多了一条细水长流的线。$AVGO
这个框架挺清楚的。一级市场锁的是五年后的算力版图，二级市场算的是下个季度的融资成本和回报时间。信用市场已经在定价这种分歧：Morgan Stanley 的数据里，NVDA、AVGO、ORCL 的 CDS 利差都走阔到了纪录高位。$AVGO

Production inference is the part that matters. TPUs are no longer just a training story. Since Broadcom co-designs these chips with Google, every hyperscaler TPU deployment lands in Broadcom's custom XPU pipeline too. $AVGO
公开口径里没见过 Jericho3 具体的出货量数字，这类交换芯片基本是 hyperscaler 定制部署，各家的用量和 GPU 配比也没怎么披露过。

Picks and shovels is right. If that $35-40B Q4 capex number holds vs $18-19B estimates, it's the same dynamic as hyperscaler spend: every extra capex dollar turns into silicon and networking content, and AVGO sits on both sides of that trade.
Meta 1GW 的 Prometheus 集群，后端网络用的是 Arista 7800 机箱配博通 Jericho3：单栋楼 fabric 挂 20,736 颗 GPU，region pair 直接给 multi-Pbps。继 IceCube 之后，又一个头部 hyperscaler 把百万卡级集群的后端网络写进了官方工程博客。以太网这条路，越走越实了。$AVGO

Small timing note: the $1.5B Fort Collins part dates back to Apple's July announcement — the fresh names here are Qnity and Perryman. Still, it's a concrete datapoint on how much of that $600B is landing on US chip supply.
